verdict.rationale: OpenTofu ships a first-party `tofu test` command. It runs automated assertions against your configuration and destroys the resources it created once the test completes. Speculative `tofu plan` runs also let developers preview the effect of changes without applying them. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that test runs are isolated from production state (tests create real infrastructure), evidence of mocking or offline testing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
